summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the new 'Consolidated by Subscriber' view on /operator/invoices. All 9 test cases from the review request PASSED. Default flat table with 7 columns renders correctly. The view-mode-toggle (flat/grouped) works and state is preserved through filters/searches. In grouped view, 13 subscriber cards were rendered for 29 invoices with correct aggregate stats (Outstanding / Paid / Invoice count), validity pills ('Monthly × N'), chevron right↔down transition on expand, individual & 'Expand all'/'Collapse all' controls, status filter (Pending → 9 subscribers · 25 invoices, 25 pending badges / 0 paid in nested rows), and name search (e.g. 'TEST' → 12 matching groups). Toggling back to Flat restores the original 7-column table with no regressions. Create Invoice dialog, Bulk Upload dialog, and the full row-action DropdownMenu (Download PDF, Edit Invoice, View Public Invoice, Send via WhatsApp Web, Mark as Paid, Mark as Overdue, Cancel Invoice) work identically in both flat and nested/grouped rows. Mixed-validity scenario was verified by seeding one Half-Yearly invoice (182d window) for an existing subscriber that already had a Monthly paid invoice: the group card correctly displayed both pills ('Half-Yearly × 1', 'Monthly × 1'), aggregated Outstanding ₹3,000 / Paid ₹500 / Invoices 2, and nested line-item pills showed '· Half-Yearly' and '· Monthly' validity labels respectively. Test data cleaned up after verification.

design_issues.screen: Grouped Invoices view - item pill formatting
issues: Minor spacing: nested item pill renders as 'TEST_HalfYearly_Plan· Half-Yearly' (no space before the '·'). The JSX concatenation relies on whitespace between sibling <span>s which the tailwind class `ml-1` on the validity span only pushes the dot rightward. Visually readable but the plan-name text and dot touch. Consider adding a single space before the middle-dot or using a gap between the two spans.

test_report_links: /app/frontend/src/pages/operator/Invoices.jsx (feature under test, unchanged by testing agent)
action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Add a space separator between the plan/description text and the '· Monthly/Quarterly/Half-Yearly/Yearly' validity suffix in renderInvoiceRow (Invoices.jsx ~line 736-740) — currently they render without whitespace between the text node and the · ….
critical_code_review_comments: groupedBySubscriber (Invoices.jsx:667-697) re-runs on every render since it's an IIFE rather than useMemo. With 29 invoices this is fine, but for operators with thousands of invoices it will cause unnecessary re-computation on unrelated state changes (dialogs, dropdowns). Wrap in useMemo(() => ..., [filteredInvoices]).

The group key fallback 'inv.subscriber_id || inv.subscriber_name || inv.id' is safe, but if two different subscribers happen to share an identical name and both have null subscriber_id, they'd be merged. Unlikely in practice but worth a code comment.

getValidityLabel (Invoices.jsx:655-664) uses Math.round on a signed ms difference — if service_end_date < service_start_date (corrupt data) it returns 'Monthly' silently. Consider guarding `if (days <= 0) return null;`.

Nested Table in grouped view (Invoices.jsx:1060-1074) has 6 columns (no Subscriber column) vs 7 in flat view. Column widths are not synchronised between groups — each group computes its own auto-width, so long invoice numbers in one group widen that card's columns differently from siblings. Visually fine with current data but may look uneven with highly variable data. Not blocking.

collapseAllGroups() simply resets to {} — if a new subscriber appears after an 'Expand all', they would render collapsed which is fine; but note that toggling filters resets visible groups while preserving expanded state for groups that re-appear, which is the desired behavior.
seed_data_creation: Inserted one Half-Yearly invoice EBILL-TESTHY-315B76 (182-day service window, ₹3,000, pending) for subscriber TEST_FirstInv_1776972110 directly into MongoDB db=saas_db to validate the mixed-validity scenario. DELETED after verification. No other test data created. Note: local backend .env DB_NAME=saas_billing_db but the live data is in saas_db — not investigated further as out-of-scope for this story, but flagged for awareness.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is purely client-side and stable. All data-testids specified in the review request are present and reachable: view-mode-toggle, view-mode-flat, view-mode-grouped, grouped-invoices-view, group-card-{key}, group-toggle-{key}, expand-all-groups, collapse-all-groups, search-invoices, create-invoice-btn. Test op cc00cc66-b87c-4e1d-997f-d1bf9dd09743 has 13 test subscribers and 29 Monthly invoices to drive the grouped view. Backend data lives in Mongo db 'saas_db' (not 'saas_billing_db' as backend/.env suggests) — use that if you need to seed more test data.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Implementation in Invoices.jsx lines 654-711 (grouping + helpers) and 894-1082 (view-aware rendering) matches the spec exactly and is integrated with the existing filter/search state so toggling views preserves user context.
